snippet.title: microJAM - Trailer 2! [Steam]
snippet.description:
yea i updated the game and added weird shit. it's been fun!

microJAM is a collection of 50 microgames with different challenges, game modes, and collectibles. you should go play it it's honestly pretty fun and i'm not sayin that bc i'm the one who made it.

here ya go ;3
